tools.name: index_dispatch
tools.description: Unified dispatcher for instruction index operations. Required: "action". Key params by action: get/getEnhanced(id, bodyOffset?, bodyLimit?), search(q/searchString/keywords/fields, includeCategories, caseSensitive, limit, mode, includeBody?), query(text,categoriesAny,limit,offset), list(category, limit?, offset?, includeBody?), diff(clientHash), export(ids,metaOnly), patch(id, op:"splice"|"append"|"prepend"|"replace", text?/find?/replaceWith?, bodyOffset?, bodyLength?, expectedSourceHash?, dryRun?), remove(id or ids, mode:"archive"|"purge"), archive(ids, reason), restore(ids, restoreMode), listArchived/getArchived/purgeArchive. Use patch to edit an instruction body in place instead of resending the whole body via add+overwrite. list/search return body-light items by default (bodyPreview+bodyLength); pass includeBody:true for full bodies or use get (supports bodyOffset/bodyLimit pagination). list/search default to INDEX_SERVER_DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE results (default 50) when limit is omitted; pass limit:0 on list to return all. Read actions accept includeArchived/onlyArchived flags (mutually exclusive). Use action="capabilities" to discover all supported actions.

action.description: Action to perform on the instruction index. Use "capabilities" to list all supported actions.

id.description: Instruction ID for get, getEnhanced, remove, inspect, governanceUpdate actions.

q.description: Single-string query for search action. The dispatcher searches the full q phrase first and, if needed, retries with split-word keywords.

keywords.description: Keywords for search action: an array of tokens, OR a single string (one or many words). A string is searched as-is first, then split on spaces if no match.

searchString.description: Ergonomic phrase input for search action. Mutually exclusive with keywords.

fields.description: Structural field predicates for search action. Unknown fields are rejected.

ids.description: Array of instruction IDs for remove or export actions.

category.description: Filter by category for list action.

contentType.description: Filter by content type for list, search, or query actions, or specify the entry content type for add action.

includeCategories.description: Search categories in addition to id/title/semanticSummary/body for search action.

caseSensitive.description: Enable case-sensitive matching for search action.

categoriesAny.description: Match instructions having any of these categories (query action).

categoriesAll.description: Match instructions having all of these categories (query action).

clientHash.description: Client-side index hash for diff action (returns changes since).

metaOnly.description: Return metadata only (omit body) for export action.

includeBody.description: Include the full body in list/search items. Default false: items are body-light (bodyPreview + bodyLength, full body omitted) to keep responses within MCP client limits. Use the get action for full content.

bodyOffset.description: Start character offset for paginated body retrieval (get action). Supplying bodyOffset or bodyLimit returns a body window plus a bodyPagination envelope; omit both to get the full body.

bodyLimit.description: Maximum number of body characters to return per page (get action). Pairs with bodyOffset for deterministic, surrogate-safe pagination.

op.description: Patch operation (patch action). splice=replace a character window at bodyOffset; append/prepend=concatenate text; replace=literal substring substitution; metadata=update title/semanticSummary/categories/primaryCategory/contentType without touching the body.

bodyLength.description: Number of body characters to remove at bodyOffset (patch action, splice op). Defaults to 0, making the splice a pure insertion.

find.description: Literal substring to find (patch action, replace op). Never interpreted as a regular expression.

replaceWith.description: Replacement text (patch action, replace op). Defaults to empty string.

replaceAll.description: Replace every occurrence instead of only the first (patch action, replace op).

expectedSourceHash.description: Optimistic-concurrency precondition (patch action). When it does not match the stored sourceHash the patch is refused with precondition_failed and nothing is written.

summary.description: Changelog summary recorded when patch is combined with bump.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (list, search, or query action). When omitted, list/search default to INDEX_SERVER_DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE (default 50). Pass limit:0 on list to return all items.

entry.description: Instruction entry object for add action. Alternatively, pass id/body/title as top-level params.

body.description: Instruction body for action="add". Current write limit: 50000 characters via INDEX_SERVER_BODY_WARN_LENGTH. Split oversized content into cross-linked instructions.

links.description: Structured cross-references to other instruction entries (add action).

lax.description: Enable lax mode with default fills for missing optional fields (add action).

entries.description: Array of instruction entries for import action, a stringified JSON array of entries, or a file path (string) to a JSON array of entries.

source.description: Directory path containing .json instruction files to import (import action).

mode.description: Import conflict resolution mode (import action) or groom mode object (groom action).

owner.description: Owner identifier for governanceUpdate action or add action.

status.description: Governance status for governanceUpdate action or add action.

bump.description: Version bump level for governanceUpdate or patch actions.

lastReviewedAt.description: Last review date (ISO 8601) for governanceUpdate action.

nextReviewDue.description: Next review due date (ISO 8601) for governanceUpdate action.

missingOk.description: Suppress errors for missing IDs (remove action).

force.description: Required for remove action when deleting more than INDEX_SERVER_MAX_BULK_DELETE items. A backup is created automatically.

dryRun.description: Preview what would be deleted without actually removing anything (remove action).

purge.description: Remove action alias for mode:"purge". Forces destructive removal (instead of upcoming archive default).

restoreMode.description: Restore collision behavior (restore action). Defaults to "reject".

includeArchived.description: Include archived entries in read results (list, query, search, categories, get, export, diff). Mutually exclusive with onlyArchived.

onlyArchived.description: Return ONLY archived entries (read actions). Mutually exclusive with includeArchived.

includeContent.description: Include full entry bodies in listArchived results (defaults to false).

body.description: Flat instruction body for action="add". Current write limit: 50000 characters via INDEX_SERVER_BODY_WARN_LENGTH. Split oversized content into cross-linked instructions.

tools.name: index_search
tools.description: 🔍 PRIMARY: Search instructions by keywords, searchString phrase input, and/or structural fields — returns instruction IDs for targeted retrieval. Supports mode: "keyword" (substring match), "regex" (patterns like "deploy|release"), or "semantic" (embedding similarity). Default mode is semantic when INDEX_SERVER_SEMANTIC_ENABLED=1, otherwise keyword. Omit the mode parameter to let the server choose the best default. Use this FIRST to discover relevant instructions, then use index_dispatch get for details.

keywords.description: Search keywords: an array of tokens, OR a single string (one or many words). A string is searched as-is first, then split on spaces if no match.

searchString.description: Phrase input for search. Mutually exclusive with keywords.

q.description: Alias for searchString (accepts the common `q` search parameter name).

query.description: Alias for searchString (accepts the common `query` search parameter name).

mode.description: Search mode: keyword (substring), regex (patterns like "deploy|release"), or semantic (embedding similarity). Default is semantic when INDEX_SERVER_SEMANTIC_ENABLED=1, otherwise keyword. Omit to use the server default.

limit.description: Maximum number of instruction IDs to return

contentType.description: Deprecated alias for fields.contentType. Filter results by content type (optional)
